title: Penguin in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='26' ry='30' fill='#4a5c8c'/>
    <!-- belly -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='16' ry='22' fill='#e8eef7'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='18' fill='#4a5c8c'/>
    <!-- face patch -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#e8eef7'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='44' cy='31' r='3' fill='#2a3550'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='31' r='3' fill='#2a3550'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='30' r='1' fill='#bfe3ff'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='30' r='1' fill='#bfe3ff'/>
    <!-- beak -->
    <path d='M50 37 L44 42 L56 42 Z' fill='#f2a33c'/>
    <!-- scarf -->
    <path d='M30 46 Q50 54 70 46 L70 52 Q50 60 30 52 Z' fill='#e8453c'/>
    <path d='M62 50 L70 70 L62 72 L57 52 Z' fill='#c9302a'/>
    <path d='M60 62 L70 62 L69 66 L59 66 Z' fill='#ffd45e'/>
    <!-- wings -->
    <ellipse cx='24' cy='68' rx='7' ry='18' fill='#3a4a75'/>
    <ellipse cx='76' cy='68' rx='7' ry='18' fill='#3a4a75'/>
    <!-- feet -->
    <ellipse cx='40' cy='94' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#f2a33c'/>
    <ellipse cx='60' cy='94' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#f2a33c'/>
  </g>
</svg>
